recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank PowerPoint slide with white background.
2. Add title text 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' near the top, large bold dark red sans-serif.
3. Insert a yellow circle at the top-right corner containing the number '26'.
4. In the top-left, create a small 2x2 table/grid with header 'Predicted as', column headers 'P' and 'N', row headers 'P' and 'N', and cells 'TP', 'FN', 'FP', 'TN'. Add vertical text 'Actual' to the left of the rows.
5. Below that table, add a rectangle with a dark red border containing the text 'Threshold=0.7'.
6. Below the threshold box, create a second 2x2 table with header 'Predicted as', column headers 'P' and 'N', row headers 'P' and 'N', and cells '3', '2', '0', '6'. Add vertical text 'Actual' to the left.
7. In the top-center/right, draw a horizontal flowchart: box 'Test Sample' with airplane icon -> arrow -> dark red box 'Model [Any value] - (0, +∞)' -> arrow -> circle with bell-curve icon -> arrow -> blue box 'Predicted Value (0 --- 1)' -> arrow -> red box 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' -> diverging arrows -> two light green ovals 'Class I' and 'Class II'.
8. In the bottom half, draw a thick red horizontal x-axis with labels '0.0', '0.5', '1.0' at left, center, and right.
9. Add a vertical dashed line at approximately x=0.7.
10. Scatter approximately 10-12 simple airplane line-drawing icons above the axis; place small red dots on some airplanes and small blue dots on others.
11. Use sans-serif fonts for all text; title should be significantly larger than body text.
